title: Formula Builder
intro: Type a formula, mark the concepts in it, and turn it into something a reader can hover, drag and step through. Export it for slides, handouts or another web page.
formulas_help: LaTeX, one formula per line, with no colours or labels.
sheet_help: Concepts and how each one looks and moves, kept apart from the formula. Write concept, then indented lines.
sheet_reference: concept NAME: PATTERN · say TEXT · unit TEXT · label above|below TEXT · brace above|below TEXT · border · tint · pointer · shape triangle|circle|square · pattern solid|dashed|dotted|wave|double · scrub MIN .. MAX step S = V · slider MIN .. MAX step S = V · edit V · limit MIN .. MAX · hidden NAME MIN .. MAX step S = V LABEL · plot Y over X from A to B, then y from C to D, mark CONCEPT point|rise|curve|intercept x = ... · step CAPTION, then formula N, strike, focus, hide, set NAME = V
prose_help: Link words to a concept with [words](concept).
budget_note: A concept past the colour budget gets a pattern and a number, and no colour of its own.
no_selection: Click part of the formula in the reader view to select it. Click again to select a larger part.
export_header: Made with Formula Builder. Augmentations after Head, Xie and Hearst, Math Augmentation, CHI 2022, doi:10.1145/3491102.3501932.
copy_help: Copy this text and paste it where you need it.
help_scrub: Drag a number with a pattern under it sideways, or select it with Tab and use the arrow keys.
about_text: Formula Builder draws formulas with the augmentations catalogued by Head, Xie and Hearst in Math Augmentation: How Authors Enhance the Readability of Formulas using Novel Visual Design Practices (CHI 2022, doi:10.1145/3491102.3501932). Every concept carries a pattern and a number besides its colour, so the Deutan and Mono views keep its meaning. Everything runs in this tab; nothing is uploaded. Math font: STIX Two, SIL Open Font License. The Deutan preview shows the Colour view as a reader with deuteranopia would see it, so an author can check it.
privacy: Runs in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
part_words: height, base, length, width, area, volume, side, distance, speed, time, sum, term, product, factor, quotient, coefficient
part_units: cm, m, km, in, ft, mi, cm², m², cm³, m³, s, min, h, km/h, mph, g, kg, $
part_missing: This part is no longer in the formula. Remove it, or put its symbols back.
range_bad: The range needs a smallest number below the largest, and steps bigger than zero.
tiles_box: Empty box: tap to write here
tiles_locked: This line has symbols the tiles cannot show. A teacher can change it with the code.
line_last: A formula needs a line. Change its tiles instead.
block_no_parts: Make a part first: tap a symbol in the formula.
verb_other: a line only the code can change
tiles_help: Tap a tile to put the cursor after it, then press keys. A grey key does not fit there.
card_tap: Tap a symbol in the formula. Tap it again for a bigger part.
card_say: When they point at it, say
card_words: In the sentence, it is called
card_number_only: Readers can change a part that is one symbol.
blocks_help: Drag a block to move it, or use its arrows. Each step shows its blocks in order.
sentence_help: Plain words about the formula. A part's card links its words.
kid_view_preview: As a colour-blind reader sees it
kid_intro: Pick a formula from the shelf. Tap a part to say what it is, then add steps to show how it changes.
kid_help_scrub: Drag a number with a line under it sideways, or tap it and use the arrow keys.
explore_intro: Hover a part to read what it is. Drag a number or a slider, and press Play to see the steps.
